commands.command: cargo test -p quansio-machine --lib gateway  # wire frames survive the wire; an unknown kind and an oversize/misshapen frame are refused; gateway rules unchanged

cargo test -p quansio-qworkerd --test executor --test daemon_binary --test host  # 10 executor tests on a real filesystem and shell (write/read/patch/conflict/escape/exec/bound/once/unhosted); the real qworkerd binary as a child process: dials in, refuses with no lease or a stale generation, runs once, heartbeats, answers a re-delivered dispatch from its record after a reconnect, refuses a missing root and an unknown flag

QUANSIO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=<dev stack> cargo test -p quansio-server --test worker_host  # 9 tests against real PostgreSQL leases, a real Unix socket and a real worker session: no worker -> WORKER_UNAVAILABLE and never the stub; fs.write/fs.read/terminal.exec land on the worker's disk under a live lease; an escaping path is a failed result; only a READY target that dials in gets a worker, one worker per target; a lost worker releases its lease; an unanswered dispatch is Unknown and sent once; heartbeats keep a 2 s lease alive for 6 s and record observed_state; a silent worker is fenced and nothing runs; a revoked lease stops forwarding before its cached expiry
uv run --python 3.12 python scripts/ci/arch_check.py && pytest tests/architecture  # 129 passed: forbidden wiring clean, WorkerHost composition gap closed and removed from KNOWN_GAPS
cargo clippy -p quansio-qworkerd -p quansio-machine -p quansio-server --all-targets -- -D warnings  # exit captured before filtering

scratchpad smoke.sh: quansio-dev-seed create --worker; quansio-server with QUANSIO_WORKER_SOCKET; a separately started qworkerd. Socket mode 0600; lease held by the hub with the target READY and observed READY; stopping the worker releases the lease

mutation checks: A substrate gate, B heartbeat renewal, C control-plane lease check, D output bound -- all KILLED; E (lease held before granted) SURVIVED as an equivalent mutant (documented); every mutant COMPILES; the restored control passes
